title: VOOL LMC – load management controller for EV charging
description: Use the full capacity of your grid connection. VOOL LMC balances the load and switches phases automatically, so fuses stay safe.

sections.title: Use your full grid capacity. Keep every fuse safe.
sections.lead: The LMC sits in your electrical cabinet, measures the building’s load in real time and gives the spare capacity to the chargers. No grid upgrade needed.

items.title: Protects the main fuse
items.text: If one phase fills up, charging moves to a less loaded phase or slows down. The load stays balanced.

items.title: Works on its own
items.text: Nothing to configure day to day. The VOOL App shows electricity use and phase load in real time.

items.title: Nobody notices
items.text: When it steps in, the car keeps charging, the lights stay on and the washing machine finishes its cycle.

sections.alt: VOOL LMC mounted in an electrical cabinet
sections.title: One controller for the whole site
sections.text: One LMC Pro manages more than 100 chargers and supports load management at several levels of the electrical installation. On a business campus in Luxembourg, one tenant runs 45 VOOL chargers on a single 125 A connection.
points: Mobile internet, WiFi, Ethernet and Bluetooth

items.title: LMC Pro
items.text: For apartment buildings, offices and car parks. Manages 100+ chargers. Available now.

items.title: LMC S
items.text: For houses and small sites with up to four chargers. Current clamps are included in the box and setup is done over Bluetooth in the VOOL App. Available from January 2027.

labels.note: Simplified simulation with an example load curve. Without load management, 16 A per phase is reserved for each charger at the building’s peak. With VOOL, the spare current on each phase is shared and each car is moved to the freest phase (minimum 6 A).

sections.title: Planning a larger installation?
sections.lead: Send us the number of parking spaces and the size of the main fuse. We will tell you what fits.
